scope: Development on previously inspected saved RGB only; no independent validation claim

chromatic.red_direction_estimation: median of top chroma quartile among RGB-only red seeds r>=100,r-g>=50,r-b>=35; fixed fallback if fewer than 12

shape_gate.note: Same rigid size/consistency thresholds as v1; fractional antialias evidence is preserved, never relax geometry to make malformed predictions scoreable

termination.basis: Old 24-state saved calibration maximum absolute error 0.025193 rounded up to 0.03; development empirical floor, not a confidence interval or guaranteed bound on new/generated images. Fit residual is never a probability.

local_validity: Object, shape and pusher are independent records. Coverage requires valid rigid shape/object pose, not pusher. A raw endpoint measurement never repairs unknown stopping history.
